description: A venue operations director must approve the binding production plan for a live filmmaker Q&A at an outdoor festival courtyard, including the microphone system, recording format, public release date, and required production commitments.

shared_context.S1: The festival's outdoor courtyard will host a live filmmaker Q&A after the evening screening.
shared_context.S2: The Q&A is planned for four speakers and will be recorded for the festival's podcast feed.
shared_context.S3: Mara must approve the final production and release plan before the courtyard is opened to guests.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard production meeting requires the sound and rights leads to submit recorded status-report entries before Mara signs off on the plan.
shared_context.S5: The approval agenda is limited to the microphone setup, recording format, podcast release date, and completion of the two required status-report entries; no additional capture or archival-production decisions are part of this approval.

PF1.text: Jonah completed an RF survey of the courtyard after the soundcheck and found that wireless microphones are unreliable there because of interference from the neighboring broadcast compound; the Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones, and the survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed with the filmmaker's representative that the appearance release permits an audio-only recording, prohibits public video release, and allows the podcast episode to be released only on September 15, 2026; the confirmation arrived after the rights packet was circulated and has not yet been entered in the event file.

acceptance_conditions: The Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones.
Wireless microphones must not be permitted.
The public release date must be exactly September 15, 2026.
A sound-system documentation commitment targeting Jonah and referring to the RF survey report and production folder must be logged.
A rights-documentation commitment targeting Elena and referring to the appearance release and event file must be logged.
The rights restriction must be cited by the decision-maker after being spoken aloud by its owner.

content_checks.C1: decisions['wireless_microphones_permitted'] == False and decisions['microphone_setup'] in ['four wired microphones', 'Four wired microphones', 'exactly four wired microphones', 'Exactly four wired microphones', 'Four wired microphones, one for each speaker', 'Exactly four wired microphones, no wireless microphones']
content_checks.C3: decisions['recording_format'] in ['audio-only', 'Audio-only', 'audio-only recording', 'Audio-only recording', 'audio-only recording for the podcast feed', 'Audio-only recording for the podcast feed']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['status_report_submission', 'submission_required', 'submission', 'sound_system_documentation'] and c['target'] == 'Jonah' and 'RF survey' in c['detail'] and 'production folder' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['status_report_submission', 'submission_required', 'submission', 'rights_documentation'] and c['target'] == 'Elena' and 'appearance release' in c['detail'] and 'event file' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The RF survey changes the microphone_setup decision to exactly four wired microphones while wireless_microphones_permitted becomes False, and it changes the commitments by requiring Jonah's RF survey report to be uploaded to the production folder.

The appearance release changes recording_format to audio-only, fixes public_release_date at September 15, 2026, requires Elena's appearance-release confirmation to be entered in the event file, and requires PF2 to be cited in justification_fact_ids.
